FLR objects for JABBA3 and FLicc

Source: R/flr_export.R
as_flr.Rd

Converts the observations of one species and iteration into FLR objects:

Usage

as_flr(data, species = NULL, iter = 1, all = FALSE)

Arguments

data

a floss_data.

species

species name; default the first. NULL with all = TRUE returns a list over species.

iter

one iteration.

all

return a named list with one element per species.

Value

a list of class floss_flr (or a list of them).

Details

  • catch: FLQuants, observed catch (t) by fleet (age "all"), and catch_total (FLQuant, all fleets), as jb3_data() of JABBA3 takes them;

  • indices: FLIndices of FLIndexBiomass, one per fleet CPUE and the survey, with the log-scale standard error (from the sampling CV) in index.var, as JABBA3 expects;

  • effort: FLQuants of effort by fleet (fishing days), for JABBA3's auxiliary data;

  • lfd: FLQuants, one per gear (fleets and survey), length (lower bin limit, cm) x year, counts summed over seasons, as FLicc's fiticc() and stocklen() take them; lfd_raised the same raised to the catch (lfd_aggregate());

  • lhpar: FLPar with linf, k, t0, M, L50, a, b, tmax and s (steepness), with a converted so that weight is in kg (FLicc convention; FLOSS uses g);

  • catch_by_gear: share of the catch by fleet over the years with length samples (FLicc's catch_by_gear).

Examples

# \donttest{
x <- simulate_fishery("lutjanus_bohar", nsim = 2, iters = 1)
#> Warning: replacing previous import ‘ggplot2::%+%’ by ‘FLCore::%+%’ when loading ‘FLRef’
f <- as_flr(x$data)
f$indices
